labels: Fine pale dust rests on the front of a dark apron, collecting more densely along a waist crease while the underlying weave remains visible.; 고운 밝은 가루가 진한 앞치마 앞면에 앉고 허리 주름을 따라 더 조밀하게 모이며 아래 직조는 드러난다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: Fine pale dust rests on the front of a dark apron, collecting more densely along a waist crease while the underlying weave remains visible.
